what_works: Hindi and mixed-language titles with high-emotion emojis (e.g., 😲, 😱, 🔥) consistently dominate the top view tiers (e.g., kAJSO4Uy3ZE, 6PHkO0E4O3E, syiXQH6LNI8).
High-performing videos almost universally feature custom thumbnails that create visual curiosity and contrast on the Shorts feed.
Geo-political, national identity, and comparative power topics ('Powerful countries', 'Highest-earning cities', 'India vs others') drive massive organic discovery and sustained views per day.
Shorter durations ranging between 30 to 50 seconds maintain stronger engagement, aligning with the channel's top performers.
Strong inquisitive hooks in titles directly addressing the viewer or posing a direct question ('भारत किस नंबर पर है?', 'क्या UK टूटने वाला है?') yield high initial engagement.

diagnosis.hook: The channel struggles when titles are purely descriptive or in English ('Photosynthesis Explained', 'The Incredible Power of the Mantis Shrimp') rather than posing an urgent, curiosity-driven question in Hindi with emotional punctuation.
diagnosis.buildup: Low-performing videos suffer from slow academic pacing or obscure foreign history topics that fail to bridge the gap between the initial hook and viewer retention within the first 15 seconds.
diagnosis.visuals: There is a direct correlation between missing custom thumbnails and near-zero views; top videos rely heavily on high-contrast custom thumbnails to stop the scroll.
diagnosis.titles_topics: English-only scientific or foreign history topics underperform significantly compared to geopolitics, national pride, Indian history milestones, and high-impact economic/city facts packaged in Hindi.
diagnosis.other: Newly published videos naturally have low views due to age, but lack of metadata (descriptions and tags) in poorer performers further starves them of algorithm testing.

hook_rules: Always start the title and first audio beat with a direct, high-stakes question or shocking paradox.
Use power words in Hindi such as 'कौन', 'कैसा', 'क्या', and 'सच' to command immediate attention.
Keep the spoken hook under 5 seconds, avoiding slow introductions or channel branding at the start.
Incorporate local or national relevance immediately so the target audience feels personally addressed.
Avoid dry textbook definitions as opening lines; replace them with dramatic stakes or mysteries.
buildup_rules: Structure the middle beats as a rapid escalation of stakes or mounting tension rather than a flat list of facts.
Keep total video length strictly between 35 to 50 seconds to maintain optimal completion rates.
Introduce a micro-conflict or turning point every 10 to 12 seconds to prevent viewer drop-off.
Ensure the narrative flow directly resolves the central question posed in the hook just before the call-to-action.
visual_rules: Mandatory custom thumbnail for every single Short featuring expressive faces, high contrast, and bold text.
Use dynamic text overlays matching the spoken audio to retain muted scrollers.
Incorporate fast-paced visual transitions, map zooms, or archival imagery changes every 2 to 3 seconds.
Maintain bright color grading and avoid dark, muddy visual compositions that look unappealing on mobile screens.
title_rules: Adopt a bilingual or pure Hindi title strategy utilizing high-urgency emojis like 😱, 😲, and 🔥.
Frame titles around curiosity gaps or direct challenges ('क्या भारत...?', 'कौन जीतेगा...?') instead of neutral statements.
Keep titles concise and optimized for mobile screens so the entire hook is visible without truncation.
Leverage trending national, economic, or geopolitical keywords that align with TruFact's proven audience interests.
topic_rules: Prioritize geopolitics, national security, major economic comparisons, and dramatic untold Indian historical events.
Avoid oversaturated, generic animal facts or basic school science topics unless given a radical, dark, or unknown twist.
Test audience reception on high-performing themes by iterating on formats that previously crossed the 1,500-view threshold.
avoid: Publishing Shorts without a custom thumbnail.
